notes.title: Click Here - Mid-Year Update
notes.notes:
It's been a while since I have clicked here, so I figured it was time for an update. Given the current success of Click Here, some features have been added to bring it to par with Click Real Fast in terms of quality and performance.


[b]Changelog 2023-05-30:[/b]
- Added support for custom cursors
- Added new cursors
- Added support for workshop cursors (upload/download)

- Added pause/play button for music

- Added multiplayer chat
- Added ability to disable multiplayer chat typing; [i]Settings > Multiplayer Chat Input[/i]

- Point counter is now hidden when paused

- Added text inversion
- Added text inversion toggle; [i]Settings > Invert Text[/i]

- Changed bloom intensity
- Color change can now be disabled; [i]Settings > Disable Color Change[/i]
- Changed game color space (Gamma -> Linear)

- Language now defaults to system language (on first play)
- Save files are backed up when changing versions*

- Various minor fixes


*See guide for Click Real Fast file restoration. Process is the same, but uses [i].ch_save[/i] files instead.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2932789648


Get the [i](much more successful)[/i] prequel, Click Real Fast

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215690/Click_Real_Fast/


Thanks for playing,
NullReferenceException

notes.title: Click Here - Anti-Nausea Update
notes.notes:
Nobody likes to [i][url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/thesaurus/toss%20one%27s%20cookies]toss-one's-cookies[/url][/i]. This update fixes the "Disable Click Effects" button not actually disabling click effects. Now, effects such as the tear inducing chromatic aberration, mind boggling screen warping, and nausea inducing text shaking can be disabled. Now you can Click Here, for longer.

Apparently the game was too hard. According to the leaderboards, nobody has been able to collect 1 million points. Yet somehow, 1.2% of players have "transcended to a higher state of mind, and have achieved enlightenment" :ConfusedLawyer:. In any case, the gameplay has been balanced... slightly. It's now a bit less impossible.


[b]Changelog 2023-02-06:[/b]
- Fixed "Disable Click Effect" button
- Reduced color pulse intensity
- Reduced unclicked target point deduction
- Balanced gameplay


[i]Click Here, clicking here since 4 days ago[/i]

notes.title: Click Here - Workshop Update
notes.notes:
It was inevitable, just as the prophecies foretold, you Clicked Here, and now you are reading this...

When clicking, you need to do it in style. Now, you can listen to your favourite music, view the greatest imagery, and click the designated target of your choosing, with this update for Click Here.

Choose to be a hermit, and hoard all the custom content for yourself, or share it with the world and download from the largest library of free, ready-to-use, community created content, the Steam Workshop.

See instructions for uploading to the Steam Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927606158
